title: fix(apps): set the missing language on 219 catalog apps
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Added missing language tags to 219 catalog apps, mostly listed before the field existed in 2025. This lets the 188 tagged `en` apps be considered by the site's English-only showcase instead of dropping out because their language was unset. The remaining apps received tags matching their language, including three bilingual interfaces with an English switch. Only catalog language fields changed; no apps were delisted.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden catalog, app cards gain little language labels and the English-tagged cards bloom beside a retro monitor; lime green #ecf874 glows prominently against warm cream, mint, and lavender pastels, with dark purple #110518 outlines. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, wears tiny librarian glasses, and gently sorts the cards among pixel flowers, in strictly cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
